newsitem.title: USA: FDA renews warning on illegal body-building drug.
newsitem.headline: FDA renews warning on illegal body-building drug.

text.p: Health officials Tuesday renewed their warning about an illegal drug used for bodybuilding and sometimes called a "date rape" drug.

The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) said the drug, gamma hydroxybutyric acid or GHB, was illegal in the United States. After an earlier campaign against it in 1991, the drug re-emerged and has been linked to many illnesses, and some deaths.
The federal health agency said GHB was promoted as a steroid alternative for bodybuilding and recently became more popular as a "recreational" drug for its intoxicating effects.
Law enforcement agents say it has also been implicated in "date rapes."
The FDA stressed the drug had never been approved for any use and there had been "numerous cases" reported of GHB causing vomiting, dizziness, tremors and seizures.

The FDA and the Justice Department issued warnings and started public education about the drug in 1991 when action was also taken against people making and distributing it. Recently the drug has been produced in secret laboratories.
